entities.summary: Oluwademilade "Demi" Orimoloye is a Nigerian-born Canadian former professional baseball outfielder. He attended St. Matthew Catholic High School in Ottawa, and was considered a top prospect in the 2015 Major League Baseball draft. The Milwaukee Brewers selected Orimoloye in the fourth round, and traded him to the Toronto Blue Jays in 2018.
